title: Evaluation preflight accepts a spawn whose registered check is on a since-rebound named root, and Engram refuses the submission only after the evaluator has finished
outcome: termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses at spawn, with the same reason Engram would give at submission, when the claim's registered check belongs to a named-root generation that is no longer current, so no evaluator runs and no evaluation slot or turn is spent on a judgment that cannot be recorded.
acceptance: A test shows that when an item's newest registered check was recorded under named-root generation N, and the claim's root has since been renamed to generation N+1 at the same path and commit, termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses before spawning an evaluator, naming the stale root generation and the need for a new check in the current root.
A test shows that when the newest registered check is on the current named-root generation, the spawn proceeds as today.
disposal_reason: Duplicate: Fable2 filed the same TermAl defect concurrently as w-36d0e270de9d (P1). This item's evidence note (12325 mailbox a2a71e38 #765, the verbatim 409, the archived output path) applies there.
